prevalence_and_metric_symptom: Delay causes & actual gate times (depDel, depTime) contemporaneous with departures.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Produces illusory 99% training accuracy (R^2 > 0.98) that collapses completely in operational deployment.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Restricted Pre-Flight Features: Train models strictly on planned attributes (crsDepTime, scheduled seats); isolate realized delay metrics strictly to prior lagged windows (t-1) as airside congestion indicators.

prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 35,809 blank rows in raw FOIA; 22,190 mapped to airportId = 0 (9.71M passengers).
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Creates a synthetic nationwide 'phantom hub' that corrupts baseline parameters, cluster assignments, and spatial transferability.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Strict Dimension Key Enforcement: Enforce SQL filter WHERE airportMissing = 0 AND airportId > 0 in all modeling tables. Recover fingerprintable rows via canonical checkpoint lookup; discard residual unmapped keys.

integrity_threat: Load Factor Domain Exceedance (Math domain boundary)
prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 23 route segment records reporting loadFactor > 1.00 (max: 1.0145) due to overbooking/infants.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Triggers NaN loss gradients, undefined numerical states, and fatal crashes in Beta distributions and sigmoid activation layers.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Hard Upfront Clamping: Apply loadFactor = LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0, loadFactor)) during ETL transformation before computing passenger demand features.

prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 450,973 zero rows (2.31% of data) during 00:00-03:59; skewness = 2.72.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Gaussian loss models produce nonsensical negative passenger predictions and underestimate daytime peak queue surges.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Hurdle & Tweedie Formulations: Do NOT discard zeros (they reflect true lane closures). Add is_night_closure = 1. Train with Tweedie deviance loss (p = 1.3) or a Two-Stage Hurdle model (Binary Classifier -> Count Regressor).

prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 60-180 min lead time between security screening entry and scheduled wheel-off (t_TSA << t_OTP).
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Phase-shift misspecification (t <-> t error); treats departing flights as instantaneous security demand.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Empirical Demand Convolution: Convolve flight seats into forward horizons (t+1, t+2, t+3) via Lognormal arrival density kernel (mode approx 92.5 min) with discrete weights (0.25, 0.55, 0.20).

integrity_threat: Airside Connecting Passenger Bypass (Fortress hub transfer bias)
prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 40% to 76% of passengers at fortress hubs (CLT: 76%, DFW: 55%, ATL: 64%) are connecting transfers who never clear landside TSA.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Massive structural overestimation of landside checkpoint volume at hub airfields, causing throughput paradoxes.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: O&D Scale Factor Deflation: Deflate scheduled seats by airport-specific origin-and-destination ratio: Demand = Seats * LF * gamma_OD, where gamma_OD in [0.24, 0.95] is calibrated from DB1B ticket coupon data.

integrity_threat: Extreme Class Imbalance & Cancellations (Acute disruption shocks)
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Standard loss functions ignore rare shock events, causing severe queue blowout during ground delay programs (GDPs).
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Advance vs. Tactical Decoupling: If cancelled > 24h ahead, exclude from demand. If cancelled tactically (< 2h), retain passengers in queue (they already passed TSA). Evaluate shocks via PR-AUC and Resilience Multiplier R_MASE.

prevalence_and_metric_symptom: Pre-2020 vs. 2020-2021 shock vs. post-2022 recovery dynamics; federal mask mandate repeal April 2022.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Violates statistical parameter exchangeability (f_t(tau) != f(tau)); overfits to localized recovery artifacts.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Demarcation & Walk-Forward CV: Establish May 1, 2022 boundary (providing 36 mo training + 12 mo 2025 testing); apply purged walk-forward CV with a 7-day embargo buffer and exponential sample decay W_i = exp(-lambda(T_max - t_i)).

prevalence_and_metric_symptom: Correlation r = 0.9975 between depDel and depDelMin; zero-variance features.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Inflates parameter coefficient variance, destabilizes gradient descent, and creates uninterpretable regression weights.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Parsimonious Feature Selection: Drop depDelMin, depDelGroups, and zero-variance columns; retain single canonical departure delay indicator.

integrity_threat: High-Cardinality Entity Sparsity (Lanes and aircraft tails)
prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 7,617 unique aircraft tail numbers; 7,370 physical checkpoint lanes across the nation.
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Extreme one-hot encoding sparsity (>10,000 columns); causes tree overfitting and Gram matrix inversion failure.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Hierarchical Dimension Aggregation: Map tail numbers to 40 conformed BTS aircraft models and 3 seating tiers (Regional, Narrowbody, Widebody); aggregate adjacent screening lanes into unified terminal complexes.

integrity_threat: Ingestion Shifting & Lineage Audit (FOIA schema evolution)
prevalence_and_metric_symptom: 154 records in late 2025/2026 with lane acronyms shifted into airport code columns; lane string variants (e.g. SBP01 vs BP01).
failure_mode_theoretical_risk: Silent data corruption, record drops, and unexplainable step-downs in longitudinal throughput trendlines.
methodological_cleansing_and_ml_action: Audit Lineage Metadata: Append non-destructive tracking columns: is_imputed (BOOL), imputation_method (VARCHAR), and imputation_confidence (FLOAT [0,1]).
